title: ShortVideoBenchmarkCases
description: Test cases for short commercials (8-15 seconds) covering 6 strategic categories across benchmark tenants.

cases.objective: Showcase heavy-duty soil cultivator / sprayer machine in pristine studio-lit field transition, highlighting solid mechanical build and brand reliability.
cases.required_logo: Bofe official vector logo with authentic yellow/green brand accents
cases.required_product: Bofe industrial agricultural sprayer equipment with distinct tank contour and hydraulic arm geometry
cases.required_environment: Modern agricultural open field at dawn with dry tilled earth, morning dew, warm natural sunlight

success_criteria.product_grounding: Machine silhouette and mechanical arm structure identical to reference image
success_criteria.motion: Smooth dolly forward with natural soil dust particles kicking up under slow wheel rotation
success_criteria.branding: Logo visible without warping or AI character hallucination; deterministic final overlay
success_criteria.duration_adherence: Generated video duration must be between 8s and 12s

cases.objective: Cinematic low-angle tracking shot of premium architectural red clay bricks stacked in precision geometric pattern on a contemporary construction site.
cases.required_product: Terracotta architectural clay brick with precision rectangular edges, porous acoustic cavities, and natural terracotta clay texture
cases.required_environment: Architectural high-end modern building construction site with clean concrete, scaffolding accents, and golden hour rim lighting

success_criteria.product_grounding: Exact red-orange terracotta color (CIELAB ΔE <= 10), rectangular structural edges preserved without melting
success_criteria.motion: Controlled cinematic orbital pan with shallow depth of field (bokeh background)
success_criteria.branding: Clean contrast, brand color adherence, authentic architectural context

cases.objective: Demonstrate the precision mist discharge of the Bofe orchard spraying rig moving steadily between rows of fruit trees.
cases.required_product: Bofe orchard fan sprayer attachment hitched to agricultural tractor
cases.required_environment: Symmetrical orchard grove with apple or olive trees, sunny afternoon, clear blue sky

success_criteria.product_grounding: Fan housing, nozzle arc, and tank maintain fixed geometry during active spraying
success_criteria.motion: Realistic fluid particle dynamics of fine water mist dispersing symmetrically through tree branches
success_criteria.forbidden_check: Zero resemblance to car wash foam or high-pressure domestic cleaning

cases.objective: Highlight data intelligence platform on executive glass screens in a high-tech corporate operations center, communicating security and real-time enterprise insights.
cases.required_logo: Veri Burada corporate emblem and minimalist sans-serif wordmark
cases.required_product: Veri Burada analytics intelligence suite interface displayed on ultra-thin ergonomic monitors and holographic glass board
cases.required_environment: Modern enterprise analytics boardroom or operations command room with soft ambient blue lighting, architectural glass, and city skyline view

success_criteria.product_grounding: Dashboard data graphs maintain crisp lines without surreal illegible glyph melting
success_criteria.motion: Smooth camera pull-back revealing modern office setting and professional analysts
success_criteria.branding: Deterministic corporate palette (deep navy blue, tech cyan, clean white)

cases.objective: Authentic creator POV unboxing and applying organic vitamin C serum in naturally lit bathroom setting with enthusiastic authentic pacing.
cases.required_product: Amber glass serum bottle with white rubber dropper bulb and gold collar
cases.required_environment: Aesthetic minimalist bathroom with white marble countertop, potted eucalyptus plant, morning window light

success_criteria.product_grounding: Glass dropper bottle shape, amber hue, and label placement identical to reference
success_criteria.motion: Natural handheld camera micro-shake, fluid serum drop viscosity, human hand anatomical correctness (5 distinct fingers)

cases.objective: Appetizing slow-motion reveal of freshly baked sourdough bread being pulled apart, showing steaming airy crumb and golden crispy crust.
cases.required_product: Artisan sourdough boule with rustic flour dusting and ear-score crust
cases.required_environment: Rustic wooden baker's table with scattered organic flour, sourdough starter jar in soft focus background

success_criteria.product_grounding: Golden blistered crust texture, natural flour dusting, authentic airy alveoli crumb structure
success_criteria.motion: 60fps slow-motion pull showing steam release without gelatinous morphing
